title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Fatal Protocol Error Expansion Work Item
summary: Add DoQ fatal protocol-error handling for truncated responses, extra response bytes, inbound unidirectional streams, and connection-close semantics.
planned_changes:
- Treat early response FIN and extra response bytes as fatal protocol errors on the client.
- Reject inbound unidirectional streams on the server with a fatal connection close.
- Keep the shared connection-close and error-code behavior trace-linked to the fatal protocol-error requirements.
- Add focused loopback tests and a requirement-home test for the covered fatal protocol-error requirements.
verification_plan: Run the DoQ fatal-protocol-error tests, the RFC 9250 requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Missing expected STREAM FIN timeout policy.
completion_notes: The DoQ adapter now closes the fatal-protocol-error loop for truncated responses, extra response bytes, and inbound unidirectional streams, while keeping the remaining fatal protocol-error cases as explicit follow-up scope.
